# govulncheck advisories accepted with justification.
#
# The CI vuln-scan job fails on any vulnerability that govulncheck finds
# AFFECTING our code (a symbol-level/called finding), EXCEPT the OSV IDs listed
# here. New or newly-reachable vulnerabilities still break the build.
#
# Format: one `GO-YYYY-NNNN` per line; `#` starts a comment. Keep a reason.
#
# ── Moby DAEMON-side advisories (github.com/docker/docker) ───────────────────
# Thulu is a Docker *client*: it talks to the daemon over the API and never
# runs the vulnerable server code. govulncheck flags these only because the
# client SDK and the daemon ship in one Go module (+incompatible, so no
# fine-grained reachability) — the example traces reach package init() only,
# never the AuthZ-plugin / plugin-privilege symbols. No client-side fix exists
# ("Fixed in: N/A"). Production safety against these depends on the host's
# Docker Engine being patched, which is ops hygiene outside this build.
GO-2026-4887  # Moby AuthZ plugin bypass on oversized request bodies
GO-2026-4883  # Moby off-by-one in plugin privilege validation
GO-2026-5617  # Moby docker cp race — daemon-side bind-mount redirection
GO-2026-5668  # Moby docker cp symlink swap — daemon-side empty-file creation
GO-2026-5746  # Moby PUT /containers/{id}/archive — daemon-side host exec
